Method of Attack: Cryptocurrency mining campaign using coin miner XMRig running under the names 'salt-minions', 'salt-minions-bak', and 'salt-store'.
Exploitation of SaltStack vulnerabilities CVE-2020-11651 and CVE-2020-11652 to gain root-equivalent access to Salt master servers and deploy coin miners.
Impacted Systems: Ghost blogging platform (Ghost Pro and Ghost.org billing services)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of SaltStack vulnerabilities CVE-2020-11651 and CVE-2020-11652 allowing unauthenticated remote root-equivalent access to Salt master servers.
Remote unauthenticated attacker queuing commands on Salt master publish server and path traversal to read/write files and steal secret keys.
Indicators of Compromise: High CPU usage spikes due to coin mining
Presence of rogue salt-minion processes running coin miners
Overloaded systems and service outages in impacted platforms
Comments and reports on Salt’s bug page indicating intrusions
Legacy CT log 2 key compromise at DigiCert
Public exploit code versions circulating in the wild
